stem: A tracking tag fired twice on some email clicks, so each of those clicks appears twice in the touch data. What does this do to a linear attribution report?

options.text: Email gets more credit and other channels less, while the total stays the same
Nothing changes, since linear gives each channel in a path one equal share
Total credited revenue rises, since every order with an email is counted twice
Only last click is affected, since linear attribution ignores repeated touches
